sections.title: The letter гэ
paragraphs: The letter (гэ) /ɡɛ/ usually sounds like the sound /ɡ/, that is a hard g. You hear it in the word (город) /ˈɡorət/, which means city or town. This letter can make four different sounds.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: Press the back of your tongue against the soft roof of your mouth. Release the air suddenly with voice. For the soft sound, arch the middle of your tongue upward as you release the burst. For the third sound, keep the same mouth shape, but do not use your voice. For the last sound, press your top teeth against your lower lip and blow voice through.

sections.title: Reading this letter
paragraphs: Before hard vowels and voiced consonants, it makes the sound /ɡ/, that is a hard g, as in (глаз) /ɡlas/. Before soft vowels or a soft sign, it makes the sound /ɡʲ/, that is a soft g, as in (где) /ɡʲdʲe/ and (гитара) /ɡʲɪˈtarə/. At the end of a word or before voiceless consonants, it sounds like the sound /k/, as in (друг) /druk/ and (когти) /ˈkoktʲɪ/. In adjective and pronoun endings, it makes the sound /v/, as in (его) /jɪˈvo/ and (белого) /ˈbʲɛləvə/.

sections.title: Tips for English speakers
paragraphs: Do not puff a breath of air when making the sound /k/ at the word end. English words like back have a puff. Stop the breath firmly. Do not replace the soft sound with a separate sound like the y in yet. Raise your tongue while releasing the burst.
